create_geometry_dataclass: create a frozen dataclass representing magnetic geometry with toroidal flux, area, and metric coefficients
stack_geometries_batch: stack a sequence of Geometry objects into a single batched Geometry with a leading time dimension
update_geometries_Phibdot: update Phi_b_dot in two Geometry objects for a time interval using their boundary flux values and dt
increase_grid_resolution: increase the resolution of a 1D face array by linear interpolation with a given integer factor
face_to_cell_interpolate: interpolate face values to cell values using linear averaging of adjacent face values
